# SMA-PME Research

> SMA-PME Research is an approved 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization (incorporated June 11, 2021, approved as 501(c)(3) on February 2, 2022) dedicated to funding breakthrough research into Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Progressive Myoclonic Epilepsy (SMA-PME) and related acid ceramidase (ASAH1) deficiencies, including Farber disease. SMA-PME is an ultra-rare, fatal genetic neurodegenerative disease with an estimated 1–4 new cases diagnosed worldwide per month.

## Mission
Three-pronged strategy: Find the Children (identify undiagnosed cases worldwide), Finance the Cure (fund medical research and clinical trials), and Streamline the Research (accelerate collaboration between researchers and families).

## Key facts
- Disease: Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Progressive Myoclonic Epilepsy (SMA-PME), caused by mutations in the ASAH1 gene (acid ceramidase deficiency). Related to Farber disease.
- Organization type: 501(c)(3) public charity, USA.
- Website: https://sma-pme.org
- Contact: hope4adeline@gmail.com / 843-902-7411
- Flagship event: ACDase Deficiency Global Forum (periodic international gathering of families and researchers; 4th edition scheduled February 17, 2027).
- Ways to donate: Zeffy, PayPal Giving Fund, Zelle, check by mail.
